bio.text: Andy Barr has served as the U.S. Representative for Kentucky's 6th Congressional District since 2013.
He chairs the Financial Institutions and Monetary Policy Subcommittee of the House Financial Services Committee, according to his House biography.
He graduated from Henry Clay High School in Lexington in 1992, received a bachelor's degree from the University of Virginia in 1996, and earned a law degree from the University of Kentucky in 2001.
